title: Grateful Dead Live at Kiel Auditorium on 1973-10-29
source: MSR> C> DAT> Circulation> EAC> SHN

ai_review.summary: High‑energy show with ripping Eyes, monster Other One and epic Sugar Magnolia; solid soundboard recording though occasional high‑note guitar distortion.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised for Jerry’s lyrical enunciation, soaring vocals on Wharf Rat and a blistering take on Eyes of the World, plus a standout Other One, Sugar Magnolia and Casey Jones. Reviewers note the recording is generally clear and well‑balanced (soundboard), but one listener reports distortion when Jerry hits high notes. Overall the show is considered a must‑listen despite an unremarkable setlist flow.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong musical performance highlighted by several standout songs and generally good soundboard quality; minor guitar distortion noted, leading to a solid but not perfect rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear overall mix with good balance; however one reviewer mentions noticeable distortion on high‑note guitar passages.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Setlist deemed unremarkable by a reviewer, but the band's energy and transitions keep the show engaging.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for beautiful vocal enunciation and note‑holding; however, one reviewer notes distortion when he hits high guitar notes.
